Commentary.Commentary: James Anderson and Stuart Broad were impressive too and picked up two wickets apiece. Joe Root was attacking with his captaincy and kept on putting pressure on the visitors. A good show from the middle and lower middle order helped them avoid the follow-on and reduce the deficit to some extent. The home side will look to come out and play their natural game. Can the Protea pacers take some quick wickets and impose themselves on the opposition? Join us in a while.

Fifties lower down the order from de Kock and Philander have taken South Africa past the 350-run mark. It could have been a lot worse barring their effort. England have gained a handy lead of 97 runs on this track which is getting slower and lower. Moeen Ali was the star for them as he finished with four wickets. He extracted sharp spin and bounce from the track utilizing the rough patches. Liam Dawson was effective too but not as threatening as his spin partner.

OUT! Moeen Ali finishes things off. He gets a 4-fer. He tosses it up on off, Philander comes down the track and tries to heave it but gets an inside edge onto the pads and then it deflects onto the stumps. He might consider himself a bit unlucky there. He has played a fine hand for his team. SOUTH AFRICA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 361!
Flighted outside off, turning back in. Philander defends it off the front foot.
Loopy ball outside off, Vernon drives it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on off, Philander drives it back to Moeen Ali.
Flatter outside off, turning back in. Philander defends it off the front foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Moeen Ali to roll his arm over now.
6th Test fifty for Vernon Philander.

Fires it in on middle, gets some away turn. Philander gets it off the outside edge down to third man for three. It also brings his fifty up and he will remain on strike for the next over. A good knock by him. He has contributed with handy runs for South Africa.
Mid on comes up.
In the air... but safe! Tosses it up on middle, turning back in. Morkel heaves it on the bounce to mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Dances down the track and drives it towards mid off for a run. There is a shy at the striker's end but he misses.
Quicker on off, Philander tries to dab it but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards the off side.
Flatter on off, turning back into the batsman. Morkel flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. He wanted a second but Philander sends him back.
FOUR! Full again outside off, Philander lifts it over covers for another boundary.
Square leg comes up to save the single.
Angles it in on the pads, Philander flicks it to deep square leg but does not run.
FOUR! CREAMED! Full on off, Philander drives it through extra cover for a boundary. He is playing a handy knock here.
Good length ball, jags back into the batsman. Philander tries to defend it but is beaten and is struck near the groin area.
A tad fuller on off, Philander defends it off the toe end of the bat.
Length ball on off, coming back in. Philander looks to defend it but gets struck on the thigh pad.
Flatter on middle, Morkel defends it off the back foot.
BEATEN! Floats it outside off, Morkel looks to defend it but is beaten by the slight away turn.
Loopy ball on middle, Morkel heaves it to mid-wicket who is a bit deep. He refuses for a run this time.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on leg stump, Vernon flicks it through mid-wicket. He takes a run this time.
Tosses it on leg middle, Philander gets it off the inner half onto his pads.
Length ball outside off, Morkel lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single. Morkel has one ball to face.
EDGY FOUR! Bowls a bouncer on leg stump, Philander tries to pull but gets a top edge over the keeper for a boundary. These are important runs for South Africa.
Bangs it in short on middle, Philander pulls it towards deep square leg. He decides not to run.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Philander slaps it through backward point for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Morne Morkel is the last man in.

OUT! What a review by England. They have got the breakthrough. Liam Dawson gets his second. Sees Maharaj coming down the track and bowls it a little quicker on middle. Keshav tries to defend it but is struck on the front pad. They all appeal and Bairstow is very confident. The umpire gives it not out. Root after talking to his teammates decides to review. They go upstairs. Replays show that the front foot is fine. There is no inside edge. It is actually pad first and then bat. The ball pitches in line, strikes him in line and is hitting the top of the stumps. The on-field call has to be overturned. England are ecstatic. South Africa lose their ninth. Maharaj has to depart after playing a gritty knock.
England take a review against Maharaj and it is regarding an LBW decision. It looks a little high.
Floats it on off, Philander drives it towards mid off and sets off for a run. Root scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but no damage done.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifts it onto the pads, Maharaj tries to flick it but misses and the ball hits the pad and rolls towards short fine leg. They run a leg bye.
Drags his length back, gets some turn away from the batsman. Vernon taps it towards covers for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Philander drives it back to the bowler.
Good length on middle, Maharaj defends it off the back foot.
A tad fuller in length, the batsman pushes it to mid-wicket.
Shorter in length on off, Maharaj guides it to gully. Keaton dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Almost an edge there. Short and outside off, Maharaj tries to cut but gets beaten.
Bangs it in short outside off, Keshav lets it through to the keeper.
Angles it into the pads, Maharaj flicks it to front of square on the leg side.
SHARP TURN! Floats it on off, gets some sharp turn away from the batsman. Philander plays it well onto the ground by removing his bottom hand off the bat.
A tad short on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
Bowls an arm ball on middle, Philander tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. There is a muted appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter on off, skids on with the arm. Philander defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up on off, a little turn away. Philander defends it off the front foot.
That was timed beautifully! Back of a length outside off, Philander punches it off the back foot through extra cover. Broad gives it chase and pulls it back just before the rope. They run three.
FOUR! THUMPED! Short and outside off, Philander stands tall and hits it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit really hard.
Lands it on a length on off, Philander defends it to covers.
Good length on middle, Philander pushes it to mid on.
A tad fuller swinging in to middle, Philander flicks it to square leg.
Back of  a length outside off, Philander punches it towards extra cover.
Mark Wood will bowl from the other end.
Floated around off, stays low. Maharaj keeps it out.
Stays back to this one and defends it.
Short delivery on middle and leg, Maharaj whips it on the bounce to short mid-wicket. Failed to capitalize on that one.
Around leg stump this time, Maharaj prods forward in defense.
Fuller on middle and leg, Keshav defends it solidly.

FOUR! A loosener to start with after the break! A touch short around off, spinning away. Maharaj rocks back and cuts it late past slip. No protection in the deep and the ball rolls away to the third man fence.
We are back for the second session. Vernon Philander and Keshav Maharaj to continue their innings. Liam Dawson to bowl first up after lunch. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...
...Day 3, Session 2...

After that, de Kock and Philander got together and kept the scoreboard ticking. They stitched together a handy partnership of 66 runs for the 8th wicket. The former imposed himself and scored runs with freedom. He played some eye-catching strokes and scored the second fastest fifty at Lord's but departed soon after that. Philander has taken blows to his right hand and is battling it out there. He needs support from the lower order to reduce the deficit as much as possible. England on the other hand will be banking themselves to clean the tail in a jiffy. Join us in a while for the afternoon session.

We have witnessed an eventful morning session of play at Lord's. South Africa have managed to score 109 runs in 27 overs for the loss of three wickets but the ball still lies in England's court. It all started with the nightwatchman Rabada playing a gritty little knock. Bavuma played well for his fifty but fell to the guile of Moeen Ali. He got turn and bounce and was the pick of the bowlers once again.
Bowls it on a length on off, Maharaj taps it to covers and takes a run. THAT IS LUNCH ON DAY 3.
Good length on off, Maharaj defends it off the front foot. Maharaj wanted a run but Philander sends him back.
Lands it on a length on off, Philander plays it with soft hands towards cover for a run.
Bangs it in short outside off, Philander tries to pull but misses.
Length ball on middle, Maharaj gets it off the inner half through square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Maharaj pushes it off the back foot through point for two.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker outside off, turning back in. Philander tries to defend it but gets an outside edge on the bounce to slip.
A tad short outside off, Philander cuts it to point.
Tosses it up on off, Philander defends it off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, Maharaj tries to defend it but gets an outside edge through short third man for a run.
Drags his length back outside off, Philander cuts it through covers for three.
Sprays on the pads, Maharaj tries to flick it but misses and is struck on the pads.
Bangs it in short, Maharaj ducks under it.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Keshav Maharaj comes out to bat.

OUT! Superb catch. It had to be something special to get rid of him. A tad fuller angling away from the batsman. De Kock drives it uppishly towards cover-point where Ben Stokes dives to his right and takes a good low catch. That was good captaincy by Root. He had the right man at the right spot. De Kock walks back with a dejected look on his face. A big wicket for England. He was looking very dangerous out there. South Africa still trail by 144.
Angles it onto the pads, Philander misses the flick and the ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg for a leg bye.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
10th Test fifty for Quinton de Kock.

FOUR! Reaches to his fifty in style. Almost a replica of the boundary he scored previously in this over. Comes down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence. It has been a breezy innings by him and he knows he has to continue. This is the second fastest fifty at Lord's.
Loopy ball outside off, de Kock drives it to cover.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Slower through the air, turns away from the batsman. De Kock tries to cut but gets beaten. There is a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.
FOUR! Great use of the feet there. Moeen Ali gives it air on middle, de Kock comes down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tosses it up on leg stump, de Kock plays it to short leg.
Moeen Ali comes back into the attack.

Philander is stinging with pain again! Good length ball on off, gets some extra bounce. The batsman tries to defend it but the ball hits him on the splice of the bat and there was also some glove there.
Full ball on middle, Philander drives it to mid on.
Lands it on a length on off, jags back in a little. Philander tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Just ahead of a length, Philander defends it to mid off.
Good length on off, Philander defends it off the back foot.
A tad short outside off, Philander tries to pull but does not connect.
Good length outside off, de Kock tries to cut it but gets beaten because of the low bounce.
FOUR! On the other side this time. Full on middle, de Kock flicks it through wide mid on for a boundary. Broad is proving to be a bit expensive today.
Length ball outside off, pushed to covers.
50-run stand between Quinton de Kock and Vernon Philander.
FOUR! WOW! Top shot. Broad changes his angle. Comes over the wicket and bowls it full outside off. De Kock leans into it and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
A tad fuller outside off, de Kock tries to drive it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Splits the gap to precision. Full and on the pads, de Kock flicks it between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Joe Root and Ben Stokes get into a chat with Stuart Broad. It is important to get the fielders in the correct positions while bowling to Quinton de Kock.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Philander defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Philander defends it solidly.
Sprays on the pads, Philander flicks it nicely through square leg for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length outside off, de Kock pushes it through point for a run.
Length angling across the batsman, de Kock plays it to mid on.
Lands it on a length outside off, de Kock gets it off the inner half towards wide mid on and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A run completed.
Angles it into the pads, Vernon flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Good length on off, Philander defends it towards covers.
Lands it on a length on off, Philander defends it off the front foot.
Full outside off, de Kock drives it through cover-point for a run.
STIFLED APPEAL! Fuller in length and angling into the batsman, de Kock tries to flick it but gets an inside edge onto this pads.
A tad fuller on off, Philander drives it to the right of mid off. The fielder dives and makes a half-stop and deflects it to mid on. De Kock wanted a run but was sent back by Philander.
The umpires pass the ball through the 8-shaped gauge. However, it is fine to continue.
Sprays on the pads, Vernon flicks it through square leg for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Some extra bounce again. Lands it on a length on middle, Philander takes his bottom hand off while defending it.
Drifts it down the leg side, Philander goes for a one-handed flick but misses. Bairstow dives to his left and fumbles but no run taken.
Good length on off, de Kock shuffles across and plays it with soft hands on the leg side for a run.
Comes around the wicket. Bowls this one outside off, de Kock nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Philander leans into it and drives it to the right of point. Stokes dives and keeps it down to a single.
Fullish length, angling into the batsman. Philander gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller on middle, Philander defends it by covering the line of the ball.
FOUR! That was really well played. A tad short outside off, Philander guides it through backward point for a boundary.
Good length on middle, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler.
Bowls it on the stumps, Philander flicks it to the right of mid on for a run.
He is getting a lot of away movement. Good length ball on off, Philander gets it off the outer half to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Errs in line, drifts it down the leg side. Philander flicks it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. Not a good follow-up delivery.
Philander is in pain and the physio attends to him. A blow to the hand does sting. The magic spray comes out. It is his bowling hand. Let's hope it is not serious.

OUCH! Lands it on a length on off, jags back in a little. Philander tries to defend it off the front foot but is struck on the gloves due to the nasty bounce. He throws his bat away and looks in a bit of pain. There is a lot of uneven bounce on this wicket.
JAFFA! Fullish length on off, seaming away. Philander tries to drive it but gets beaten.
FOUR! This one is even better. Three in a row. A tad fuller outside off, de Kock leans into it and drives it through backward point for a boundary. 12 from the over.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. A tad short outside off, de Kock cuts it through point for a boundary. He can score some quick runs here.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Strays on the pads, de Kock flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
BEATEN! Gem of a ball there! Good length on off, nips away after pitching. De Kock pokes at it but gets beaten. He could so easily have edged that.
Lands it on a length, de Kock tries to push at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Comes around the wicket. Bowls it a tad short outside off. A loosener you can say. De Kock tries to pull it but the ball stays low and it goes under his bat.
Stuart Broad comes back into the attack. Let's see how he fares with the second new ball.

Time for Drinks. A good first hour for the home side. They have been right on the money and have troubled the visitors. Moeen Ali has been the pick of the bowlers for them. However, the good thing for the Proteas is that they have managed to avoid the follow-on. A gritty knock from the nightwatchman Rabada helped them keep the scoreboard ticking. Quinton de Kock has come out and is scoring runs with freedom. England will know how dangerous he can be and will be aiming to get rid of him quickly. Another absorbing passage of play awaits!
Similar length on off, Philander pushes at it but gets it off the outer half to gully.
Another beauty of a delivery! Hurls this one in the off stump channel, Philander feels for it but is foxed completely.
Length delivery on off, Vernon defends it solidly this time.
That's a peach! Good length delivery around off, seams away substantially after landing. Philander has no choice but to play at it and is beaten comprehensively.
It's a brand new ball and it doesn't bounce at all. That will tell you the story. Bowls this one outside off, stays extremely low and seams away. Philander doesn't bother playing at it.
Starts off with a fullish delivery slanting down the leg side, de Kock helps it to fine leg for a single. South Africa manage to avoid the follow-on
James Anderson is into the attack.
The second new ball has been taken.
Once again hangs deep inside the crease and keeps it out. South Africa need one more run to avoid the follow-on.
A bit short, turning into Philander. He stays back and defends it solidly.
De Kock takes a couple of steps down the track and strokes it through mid on for a run.
Floated on off, pushed back to Ali.
Quinton uses his feet and turns it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Well played! He is a dangerous player and accumulates his runs at a brisk pace. A bit shorter on off, turning away. De Kock rocks back and punches it through covers for an elegant boundary.
Drifting into Philander. He defends it tentatively.
A bit flatter on middle and leg, defended towards short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quinton waits for this one to turn into him and works it around the corner. A run taken.
De Kock stays back and punches this one to mid off.
FOUR! Shot! Shorter this time on middle and leg, de Kock pulls it through square leg to find the fence. England need to be careful here.
Vernon Philander comes out to bat. The second new ball is no available.

OUT! Brilliant bowling from Ali and he gets the reward! This is his third wicket and thoroughly well-deserved. He floats this one nicely outside off, it holds its line. Bavuma plays for the spin but gets foxed. Ends up getting a thick outside edge. The ball clips the thigh of Bairstow and deviates straight to Ben Stokes. The big man is alert and pouches it safely. A courageous knock from Temba Bavuma comes to an end. South Africa's worries continue.
Full outside off, driven to cover-point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slow through the air on off, patted back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery around, Bavuma leans forward and defends it solidly.
Floated on off, Bavuma hangs back and works it to mid-wicket.
Floated around off, tapped gently to covers. End of a successful over for the home side.
Bavuma turns this fullish delivery to mid-wicket to rotate strike.

A bit short outside off, Quinton hangs back and punches it wide of point. They come back for the second as the fielder hares after it. There is a bit of hesitation for the third run but they manage to come back for it. De Kock is off the mark.
De Kock stays back and defends it to the off side.
Quinton de Kock comes out to bat.

OUT! The bowling change has done the trick! Dawson gets his first wicket. He tosses this one outside off, Rabada hangs deep in the crease and plays for the turn. However, the ball goes straight on and takes the outside edge of Rabada's bat. Jonny Bairstow behind the stumps is sharp as a hawk and grabs a brilliant catch. Kagiso departs but he has done his job. South Africa still need 15 runs to avoid the follow-on.
Floated on off, Rabada lunges forward in defense.
Liam Dawson brought into the attack.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid off for a single.

FOUR! Not where he intended but he will take it. Tossed up in line of the stumps, Rabada uses his feet and tries to go over mid on. Ends up getting it from the inner half of the bat and over mid-wicket. A boundary results.
That almost zipped through! Quicker delivery on off, Rabada is late at it but gets it off the bottom half of the bat down the track.
Drifting into Rabada. He offers a straight bat in defense.
The right-hander hangs back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls this one slow through the air outside off, Bavuma shuffles across and lets it go through safely.
Similar length outside off, Kagiso doesn't fiddle with it.
Wood once again angles this away from Kagiso and bowls it on a driving length. The southapaw is drawn into it and gets foxed. Good thinking by the quickie. He is bringing the slips into play.
Length delivery slanting across the southpaw. He pushes at it with minimal foot movement and gets beaten.
Third slip comes in place for Rabada.
Short of a length on off, Kagiso stays back and defends it stoutly.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Temba cuts it towards Dawson at cover-point. He dives to his left and takes pace off the ball. A run taken.
Fuller length ball on off, Temba puts his head down and defends it calmly.
A bit flatter this time, the southpaw keeps it out.
Good fielding! Tossed up on off, Rabada smashes it towards mid on who dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.
Loopy ball on off, Kagiso lunges forward in defense.

Floated on off, Rabada drills it back straight down the ground but the ball hits the leg of the umpire and deflects to mid on. That was a sure shot boundary there. Rabada would consider himself unlucky.
A second slip in place for Moeen Ali.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

What a vicious delivery from Ali. Tosses it up nicely outside off, Bavuma hangs back and looks to defend it but gets foxed by the extra bounce. It hits him on the gloves and lobs past the right side of Gary Ballance at short leg. A run taken.
Time for spin. Moeen Ali comes into the attack.

FOUR! That's a gift and gleefully accepted! High full toss on off, Rabada just puts bat on ball and gets it past the right side of the point fielder. He hares after it but fails to prevent the boundary.
Similar length ball on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery on middle, the southpaw hops and blocks it towards short leg.
Well bowled! Wood draws Rabada forward this time and gets it to go away with the angle. Rabada falls into the temptation to drive and gets beaten all ends up.
Good length delivery on off, keeps low. Kagiso hangs deep in the crease and blocks it down the track.
Dug in short, Temba pulls it nicely to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery in line of the stumps, Temba goes hard at the pull and mistimes it to the leg side. They sneak in a single.
Stokes goes wide of the crease and angles in a fullish delivery on off. Bavuma with a still head defends it with authority.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
7th Test fifty for Temba Bavuma.

FOUR! Great way to reach his half century. Stokes bowls this one on a fuller length outside off, Bavuma drives it with an open face through cover-point and the ball whistles away to the fence. He came in at a difficult situation and hasn't disappointed. He needs to convert this into a big one.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
No ball! Length delivery on off, Temba covers the line and defends it stoutly. Stokes has overstepped once again.
Stokes comes over the wicket for the first time in the day and bowls it on a driving length outside off, Rabada creams it towards wide mid off. Ali runs to his right and keeps it down to a single.
Full length delivery around off, Bavuma puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, Kagiso pulls it hesitantly to wide mid on for a run.
Another sharp bouncer. The English bowlers have been right on the money this morning. Rabada sways away from the line of the delivery awkwardly to evade it.
A short leg in place for Rabada.
On a length outside off, Kagiso allows it through.
Angling into the southpaw, turned to wide mid on for a run.
Back of a length outside off, played with an open face to backward point.
Similar length on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Shot! Stokes opts to bowl this one on a fuller length on off. Rabada leans into it and strokes it through mid on to find the fence.
Ooh.. that was nasty! Stokes steams in and bangs in a well-directed bouncer. Rabada take his eyes off the ball, looks to sway away but takes a blow on his right shoulder. That must have stung.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. No ball signalled by the umpire.
Good length delivery outside off, Kagiso goes hard at it again and mistimes his punch to covers.
Similar length delivery outside off, the southpaw toe ends his drive to cover-point.
Fullish delivery around off, Rabada goes for a drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads. He needs to time those rather than going too hard at them.
Stays back to the good length delivery and defends it to short cover.
Some reverse for Wood again. Tailing in on off, Bavuma jams it out to mid on.
On a length outside off, shapes away a touch. Temba doesn't fiddle with it.
That stayed really low! Wood bowls this one on a good length well outside off, Bavuma points his bat skywards and lets it through. That died down before reaching to the keeper.
Wood is getting good shape! Gets it to curl back into Temba. He pushes it to mid on again.
Fuller in length and tailing in from outside off, driven crisply to mid on.
Stokes keeps it fullish again, Rabada again goes at it with hard hands and mistimes it to back to the bowler. A good over from Stokes.
Back of a length delivery around off, good bounce on that. The southpaw camps back and plays it with an angled bat towards second slip.
Fullish delivery on off, Kagiso pushes at it with hard hands but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
That was a risky leave! On a length outside off, angling in substantially. Rabada leaves it alone as the ball whizzes past the off stump.
Beautifully bowled! Yorker and it shapes in sharply. Rabada looks to keep it out but is pinged on the boot. That's the perfect definition of a toe-crushing yorker.
Full length delivery, tailing in sharply to Kagiso. He looks to play it through but misses to get rapped on the pads.
Ben Stokes to bowl from the other end. He has two slips and a gully in place.
Straying on the hips, Kagiso nudges it around the corner for a run and he will retain the strike.
Well bowled! Good length delivery on off, zipping through the pitch. Rabada gets surprised a touch and plays it off the outer half to gully.
First runs of the day! Fuller length ball outside off, Rabada leans into it and strokes it sweetly through covers. Picks up two runs to his name.
Short of a length delivery, rising on Kagiso. He hops back and blocks it.
Third slip in place. Joe Root is on the attack.
Length delivery angling in from outside off, stays low again. Rabada hangs back and keeps it out.

Starts off with a fuller length delivery outside off, angling in a touch and then nips away. Rabada covers his off pole and lets it go. Another example of the wicket staying low as the ball does not carry to the keeper.
We are ready to get underway. Mark Wood will will start the proceedings. He has two slips in place. Rabada who came in as the nightwatchman and Bavuma will continue their innings.

Some more issues to ponder upon for South Africa as it was announced yesterday evening that Kagiso Rabada has been suspended for the next Test in Trent Bridge after accumulating 4 demerit points within a 24-month period for using inappropriate language to Ben Stokes on the 1st day at Lord's.

South Africa on the other hand, found run scoring difficult. They were in a spot of bother before Bavuma and de Bruyn steadied the ship. They need to apply themselves and if not overcome, then get close to the English side's total. Let's find out if they can surge a fightback. We are in for an exciting day of cricket.

Hello and welcome to the 3rd day of the 1st Test between England and South Africa at Lord's. England will be the happier of the two sides. They were disciplined with the ball and kept chipping away at the wickets. Moeen Ali and Liam Dawson got good purchase from the wicket which will dry up more as the match progresses. They would want to continue their good work today and bowl the visitors out as quick as possible.
...Day 3, Session 1...

Earlier in the day, the home side added 101 runs quickly in the first session to give their bowlers a good platform. On the other hand, the tourists were good in patches and will strive to perform better tomorrow. The track is getting slower and lower and the spinners will come more into play. Can the hosts run through the lower order in a jiffy or will the Proteas make an inspirational fightback? Join us for all the action on Day 3 at 1100 local (1000 GMT). It promises to be an eventful day of cricket. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

The English bowlers kept on trying hard all day long and kept nagging the batsmen with probing lines and lengths. Broad used the corridor of uncertainty to good effect and got rewarded with two wickets. The visitors still need 45 runs to avoid the follow-on and have five wickets in hand. Their first aim should be to go past that and take it from there. Bavuma is going strong and the away side will bank on him and de Kock to take their side to safe harbors.

A crucial breakthrough at the fag end of the day has given England the upper hand in the contest once again. Theunis de Bruyn and Temba Bavuma had battled it out and were determined to keep going but Anderson nipped out the former with a beauty. Nonetheless, the 99-run stand between the duo has given some sort of momentum to the visitors. It all started with their skipper, Dean Elgar gritting his way out along with good support from Amla. However, the guile of Moeen Ali got rid of them.
He plays out the last ball with authority. Tosses it up on off, Bavuma defends it off the front foot. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 2.

FIVE RUNS! Flighted on middle, Rabada clips it towards mid-wicket against the turn and sets off for a run. Broad takes a shy at the non-striker's end but misses by a long way. It was a wild throw from him. Joe Root who was backing up had no chance to stop it and the ball races to the cover boundary. That was needless from Broad. Replays show even if he had hit Rabada was in.
Flatter on off, Rabada defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it on off, Rabada drives it to covers.
Silly point in place now.
Drags his length back a little, Bavuma pushes it down to mid on for a run. Rabada has four balls to play now.
Loopy ball outside off, Bavuma lets it through to the keeper.
Moeen Ali to bowl the last over of the day. Can he give his side another breakthrough?

FOUR! TOP SHOT! A tad fuller outside off, Rabada drives it through covers for a boundary. That came right from the middle of the bat. The ball boy throws it back immediately so that England can get in one more over.
Shorter in length on off, Rabada defends it off the back foot.
Full ball tailing back in on middle, Rabada pushes it to mid on. He wanted a run but was sent back by Bavuma.
Full ball on middle, Rabada drives it back to the bowler.
Comes around the wicket, angles it into the batsman. Rabada defends it off the front foot.
Bouncer on middle, Bavuma pulls it through square leg for a run. That brings the nightwatchman on strike.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Rabada lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lands it on a length on off, Rabada defends it off the back foot.
Good length outside off, Rabada defends it off the back foot.
Kagiso Rabada is the new man in. He has been sent in as a nightwatchman. Can Anderson get through his defense?

OUT! Anderson strikes. He breaks the 99-run stand. What a time to get the breakthrough. Just before the close of play. Length ball on off, seams away after pitching. De Bruyn tries to push at it but gets an outside edge to Bairstow who makes no mistake. They all go up in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Anderson gets his first wicket. Theunis de Bruyn misses out on his maiden Test fifty.
Full ball on off, de Bruyn drives it back to Anderson.
OUCH! Short ball on middle, Bavuma shuffles across and tries to pull it but misses and is struck on the stomach. Broad comes running in and tries to kick the ball on the stumps but hits Bavuma.
Back of a length on off, Bavuma plays it off the back foot.
Good length outside off, Bavuma gets it off the outer half down to third man for a couple.
A tad fuller on off, de Bruyn drives it towards covers and runs a single.
Lands it on a length on off, de Bruyn defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Almost outfoxed Bavuma! The batsman walks across his stumps. Anderson bowls a full ball aiming at the leg stump. Bavuma tries to flick it but misses and the ball also misses the leg stump by a whisker.
Fuller length, tailing back in a touch on off, Bavuma drives it to mid off.
Full ball outside off, drives it to covers.
Length ball outside off, Bavuma shuffles across his stumps and punches it to point.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Bowls it full, Bavuma walks across and flicks it towards wide mid on. The fielder moves to his right, dives and makes a good stop.
Good length outside off, Bavuma guides it to point. Stokes fumbles and they run through for a single. 200 up for England.
Length outside off, Bavuma lets it go through to the keeper.
Back of a length on off, Bavuma punches it off the back foot to mid off.
A tad fuller on off, Bavuma drives it towards mid off for a run.
Length outside off, de Bruyn slices it to backward point. Bavuma looks for a run but is rightly sent back and he makes it in safely to beat Stokes' throw.
Well wide for the batsman to play a shot at it.
Stuart Broad is brought back into the attack.
Full on middle, Bavuma flicks it to mid on.
FOUR! Drifts it on the pads, Bavuma tickles it to the fine leg boundary.
Length ball on off, Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
That was well-timed but was well-fielded. Full on the pads, Bavuma flicks it to mid-wicket who dives to his left and stops it.
Lands it on a length on off, Bavuma defends it off the front foot.
A tad fuller outside off, Bavuma walks across and drives it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, de Bruyn pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! A tad short on middle, picks the length up early and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bangs it in short on leg stump, Bavum swivels and pulls it through backward square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, got some swing away from the batsman. Bavuma does not bother playing a shot at it.
Angles it into the batsman, Bavuma pushes it to mid on.
Good length on off, Bavuma punches it off the back foot to point.
Full ball on middle, de Bruyn drives it to the bowler.
Good length delivery, de Bruyn pushes it to mid on off the back foot.
Back of a length angling into the batsman, de Bruyn punches it to mid on.
Good length on off, de Bruyn defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Lands it on a length on off, de Bruyn defends it off the front foot.
A tad fuller, swinging away on off. The batsman defends it off the front foot.
Length ball on off, Bavuma defends it off the front foot.
Almost an edge there! Short and wide outside off, Bavuma tries to cut but misses.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length on off, de Bruyn plays it with soft hands towards covers for a run. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Full and down the leg side, de Bruyn tries to flick but misses. Bairstow parries it and the ball rolls to fine leg and they run two byes.
Bouncer down the leg side, de Bruyn lets it through to the keeper.
A tad fuller outside off, Bavuma drives it to point.
Back of a length on off, Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it outside off stump, no need for the batsman to play at that.
Length on off, Bavuma defends it off the back foot.

Some aggression there from Jimmy. Full ball on the stumps, Bavuma drives it back to Anderson who collects the ball and throws it back towards the stumps. The ball hits Temba's boot and deflects onto the stumps.
Full and on the pads, de Bruyn flicks it through square leg for a run.
James Anderson is back into the attack.
Good length on off, Bavuma clips it through mid-wicket for a couple. Good running there by Bavuma. He is quick between the wickets.
A tad fuller outside off, Bavuma does not bother playing a shot at it.
Shortish in length, Bavuma plays it to covers.
Short again on middle, de Bruyn pulls it to square leg for a run.
A tad shorter on middle, de Bruyn gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length on off, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Bavuma cuts it through backward point for a boundary. 11 runs from the over.
A tad shorter on middle, de Bruyn pulls it through square leg for a run.
Length outside off, de Bruyn shoulders his arms to it.
Full and wide outside off, Bavuma drives it through covers for a run.
Angles it into the pads, de Bruyn plays it on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Drifts down the leg side, de Bruyn flicks it to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Length ball outside off, Bavuma plays it to point.
Back of a length on off, Bavuma punches it off the back foot to the off side.
Bouncer on middle, Bavuma goes for the hook but misses.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

NOT OUT! England have lost a review. It was mighty close there. Full ball and tailing in on leg stump, de Bruyn tries to flick it but misses and is rapped on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side. Mark Wood tumbles in his followthrough but still appeals. The umpire gives it not out. After a chat with his teammates, Root decides to review. They go upstairs. Replays show the front foot is fine. There is no inside edge. The impact is in line but it is just clipping the leg stump. The umpire's call stays. De Bruyn survives. You can't blame England for taking a review as it looked out to the naked eye. A leg bye taken.
There is an LBW appeal against Theunis de Bruyn and it is taken upstairs. Seems close to the naked eye.
Mark Wood comes back to bowl.
Wide outside off, Bavuma lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Uppish but safe. Short and wide outside off, Bavuma cuts it uppishly past gully for a boundary.
Lands it on a length on off, Bavuma plays it to point. He sets off for a run but then refuses it.
Good length on off, Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
Full and wide outside off, the batsman reaches out to it and drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, Bavuma pushes it through cover-point for a run.
Temba Bavuma is having a bit of an issue with his boot. So a slight halt. Meanwhile, Ben Stokes is also getting a little attention from the physio.
FOUR! Good use of the feet. Flights it on off, de Bruyn comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary. These two are ticking along well here.
Good stop by Root. De Bruyn comes down the track and belts it to the left of mid on. Root dives and stops it and does not concede a run. The captain is leading by example here.
Loopy ball, turns away a little. De Bruyn tries to defend it but gets an outside edge and the ball rolls on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags his length back a little, de Bruyn punches it to mid off.
Floats it outside off, de Bruyn sweeps it through square leg for a couple. The fielder makes good ground to his left and dives and stops the ball from going for a boundary.
In the channel outside off, Temba doesn't fiddle with it.
FOUR! Elegant! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Bavuma leans into it and strokes it exquisitely through cover-point. Timing is spot on and the ball whistles away to the fence.
On a driving length outside off and invites Temba for an expansive drive. He resists the temptation.
Full length delivery outside off, driven sweetly to covers.
Angling into the hips this time, de Bruyn looks to tuck it across but the ball brushes his pads and goes behind square on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Good length delivery outside off, punched crisply off the back foot to short cover.
Drinks break.
Bowled on off, skids in with the arm. Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, gets a little away turn. Bavuma tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an outside edge to short third man. He wants a single but is sent back by his partner.
Arm ball on off, Bavuma defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Loopy ball on the stumps, Bavuma defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on middle, de Bruyn punches it towards mid on for a run.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman drives it to covers.
Good length outside off, Bavuma lets it through to the keeper.
A well-directed bouncer, Bavuma does well to evade it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR Sloppy from Keaton! Full and outside off, Bavuma drives to the left of Jennings at covers. He dives over the ball and the ball goes under him and races away to the fence.
Good length outside off, Bavuma does not bother playing a shot at it.
Length on off, Bavuma defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Full ball on middle, de Bruyn drives it back to the bowler. A maiden by Dawson.
Drags his length back a touch, de Bruyn punches it to mid on off the back foot.
Quicker and skids on with the arm, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
Flatter on off, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot. He should have been playing ahead to that one.
Loopy ball outside off, turns a little. De Bruyn watches it through to the keeper.
Tosses it up on middle, de Bruyn defends it off the front foot.
A tad fuller on off, Bavuma pushes it back to the bowler who stops it with his feet.
Length outside off, Bavuma shoulders arms to it.
Angles it on the pads, de Bruyn flicks it to the left of mid-wicket for a run.
Full and wide outside off, de Bruyn lets it through to the keeper.
Some away swing there! Length ball outside off, de Bruyn pokes at it but gets beaten.
Back of a length ball outside off, the batsman plays it to point.
Ben Stokes comes back into the attack.
Full and quicker on leg stump, Bavuma paddles it to fine leg for a couple.
Floated it on middle, Bavuma defends it watchfully.
Smart shot! Tosses it up on leg stump, de Bruyn paddles it through short fine leg for three runs.
Flatter on middle, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! A loosener first up. Short and on the pads. De Bruyn whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Liam Dawson is called back for a bowl.

Loopy ball outside off, goes on with the arm. Bavuma tries to drive but misses. The ball hits the keeper low on the pads and rolls to Cook at leg gully. He scores a direct hit at the striker's end but no harm done.
Short ball, turning in. Bavuma pulls it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Drags his length back a little, Bavuma rocks back and whips it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence. Second boundary of the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Big shot from the little man. Ali floats it up on off, Bavuma comes down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Tosses it up on off, Bavuma defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, de Bruyn plays it with soft hands to cover-point. He wants a run but is sent back by Bavuma.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length angling into the batsman who pushes it to silly mid on.
Length ball on middle, de Bruyn defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Full on the pads, de Bruyn flicks it through mid-wicket. Wood from mid on gives chase but the ball was running down the slope and he had no chance to cut it off. A boundary there.
Full and angling into the pads, the batsman flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, Bavuma shuffles across and drives it to mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Loopy ball on off, Bavuma pushes it to mid off.
Floats it outside off, Bavuma defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Tosses up outside off, does not turn. Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
Bowled outside off, de Bruyn punches it off the back foot through covers for a couple.
Lands it on a length outside off, de Bruyn punches it to point.
Replica of the last ball, de Bruyn plays it to short mid on.
Good length outside off, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot to the leg side.
A tad full on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, Bavuma pushes it to the vacant cover area for a run.
James Anderson is back into the attack. Silly mid on in position for him.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Floats it outside off, goes on with the arm. De Bruyn defends it off the back foot. He is staying back to most of the balls he is facing.
Flatter outside off, de Bruyn tries to defend it off the back foot. The ball stays a touch low and he gets a bottom edge on the bounce to the keeper.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Drags his length back a little outside off, de Bruyn tries to cut it but the ball turns in and goes off the inside edge on the off side.
FOUR! That is one way to relase the pressure. Loopy ball outside off, de Bruyn comes down the track and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Bowls it on a length on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, de Bruyn plays it with soft hands towards cover for a run.
Full ball angling in, Bavuma drives it to the right of mid on who dives and half stops it. The fielder at mid-wicket over runs it and concedes a run.
Bangs it in short outside off, Bavuma tries to pull but gets beaten. There is a stifled appeal by the keeper but nothing from the umpire.
Good length outside off, Bavuma lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Drifts on the pads, Bavuma helps it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. A much-needed boundary for South Africa.
Flatter on off, does not turn that much. The batsman defends it off the back foot.
Quicker and skids on with the arm, de Bruyn defends it by covering the line of the ball.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The fielder moves fractionally in front of square on the leg side.
Flatter on off, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot.

How has that missed the leg stump? Tosses it up outside off, de Bruyn shuffles across and tries to defend it off the back foot. The ball grips and turns and goes just over the leg stump. The ball rolls through short fine leg and the batsman run two byes.
Flights it outside off, gets sharp turn. De Bruyn tries to defend it off the back foot but is struck high on the thigh pad. There is a muted appeal but that was too high.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length on middle, Bavuma defends it off the back foot.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Bavuma nudges it to mid-wicket.
Goes a touch wider on the crease this time and bowls it outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to it.
Good bowling from Broad. Persisting with the stump to stump line. Fullish length on middle, Bavuma defends it off the front foot.
A tad fuller and tailing back in, Bavuma drives it to mid on.
Floats it on off, Bavuma goes down on one knee and sweeps it through the leg side for a run.
Loopy ball on off, de Bruyn sweeps it through square leg for a run.
BEATEN! Good bowling here. Bowls an arm ball outside off, the batsman plays for the spin but is beaten on the outside edge.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tosses it up on off, de Bruyn defends it off the front foot.
Flatter on off, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot.
That stayed low! Bavuma did well to get bat on that or else he was a goner. Broad bowls it on a length on middle, Bavuma defends it off the toe end and the ball rolls to the slip region.
Length delivery on off, de Bruyn works it on the leg side for a run.
Good length angling into the batsman, de Bruyn tries to defend it but gets it off the inner half to short mid-wicket.
Length on middle, de Bruyn defends it off the back foot.
Theunis de Bruyn comes out to bat.

OUT! Broad strikes! That was absolutely plumb. He bowls a fuller length delivery around off and gets it to tail back in a touch. Duminy tries to defend it off the front foot but misses. The ball brushes the front pad and then goes onto hit the back pad. They all go up and the umpire raises his finger immediately. He has a chat with Bavuma but decides not to review it. Duminy knew he was a goner as soon as the ball hit his pads. The visitors are in deep trouble here. They need 155 runs more to avoid the follow-on.
Good length on off, Duminy punches it off the back foot to covers.
Quicker outside off, Duminy plays it late through short third man for a run.
Full ball on off, Duminy drives it beautifully to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter delivery on middle,  Duminy looks to defend it but gets an inside edge towards short leg.
Flatter on off, skids through with the arm, Duminy manages to get his bat down in time and the ball rolls to cover.
Tosses it on middle, goes on with the arm. Duminy defends it off the front foot.
Closer to the off stump this time, Bavuma leaves it watchfully. A maiden by Broad.
Just ahead of a length outside off, tailing back in. Bavuma does not bother playing a shot at it.
Lands it on a length, Bavuma prods forward and defends it carefully.
A tad fuller and on the stumps this time, Bavuma defends it off the front foot to point.
Good length outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to it.
Length outside off, Bavuma lets it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Good shot! Flights it on off, Duminy goes down on one knee and paddles it through short fine leg. Wood in the deep makes good ground to his left but misfields and concedes a boundary. Sloppy stuff!
Tossed up on off, turns in sharply. Bavuma stays back and gets an inside edge to backward square leg. A run taken and he is off the mark.
Loopy ball outside off, Bavuma tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Flights it outside off, turns in sharply. Bavuma tries to drive it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto the boots and the ball rolls to the leg side.
Temba Bavuma is the new man in. A slip, short leg and short mid-wicket in place for him.

OUT! That's his 100th Test wicket. Earlier in the day, he also completed 2000 Test runs. Terrific bowling by him to see the back of the Protea skipper. Ali floats it on off stump and it skids on with the arm. Elgar tries to defend it but gets it off the inside edge to Ballance at short leg who takes a good catch. Ali gets his second. Elgar is walking back after a good knock. South Africa are in a bit of a bother here. They need to build a partnership.
Tosses it up on leg stump, Elgar tries to flick it but misses and is struck on the pads.
Moeen Ali to continue from the other end.
Lands it on a length on off, Duminy defends it off the front foot. A tidy first over after Tea.
Back of a length outside off, Duminy opens the face of the bat and plays it to point.
A tad fuller, nips away after pitching. Duminy pokes at it and gets an outside edge which falls just short of third slip. The slip cordon has moved in closer due to the slowness of the surface.
Good length on off, JP defends it off the back foot to gully.
Drifts on the pads, Duminy flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple. First runs after tea.
Starts off on a length outside off, Duminy lets it through to the keeper.

We are back for the final session. Dean Elgar and JP Duminy to continue their innings. 37 overs are left in the day. Stuart Broad to start the proceedings after Tea. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...
...Day 2, Session 3...

South Africa on the other hand, have added 86 runs in this session. Amla and Elgar steadied the ship with a 72-run partnership before the former had to depart. Duminy has looked good after coming out. The visitors would want a big partnership from these two. Join us for the final session in a while.

Both the sides will be happy with the second session. England started off well with the wicket of Heino Kuhn. Their spinners Liam Dawson and Moeen Ali got some good purchase off the surface, with the latter picking the all-important wicket of Hashim Amla. They have been disciplined with their lines and lengths and would want to continue the same after the break.
Flighted delivery, Elgar prods forward and keeps it out. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 2!
Loopy delivery on off, patted to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This is good bowling from Ali! Gets this one to come in with the arm. Elgar prods forward to defend it but gets it off the inside edge. The ball carries on the bounce to the short leg fielder.
Floated in line of the stumps, pushed back down the track.
Drifting in to Elgar. He looks to defend but gets it off the inner half past short leg.
Moeen Ali is back on.

That could have easily shattered the stumps! Shortish delivery around off, Duminy goes for a big pull but gets a thick inside edge onto his right boot. The ball just rolls past the off stump. Close shave that.
Three slips and a gully in place. Root is attacking a bit here.
Back of a length delivery on off, JP is squared up a touch as he plays it to gully.

FOUR! Beautiful! Wood bowls this one full outside off, Duminy is quick to transfer his weight on the front foot and creams it through covers. The timing is spot on and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Shortish delivery, angling in from outside off. Elgar pulls it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length on off, Elgar hangs back and blocks it.
Bouncer to start the over with. Elgar ducks under it.

Stokes gets this one to shape in appreciably from outside off. Duminy is caught on the crease as he looks to play it across but gets pinged on the pads. The players appeal initially but bail out of it. Ben Stokes indicates to his teammates that the angle was taking it down the leg side.
Length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Short of a length and shaping into Elgar. He hops back and works it to square leg. A run taken.
Full delivery on off, Elgar jams it back to Stokes who collects it in his followthrough and mimes a throw at the striker's end. Aggression from the big man.
Stokes errs in line again and slips this one down the leg side. Dean looks to glance it but misses.
Full length delivery outside off, Elgar puts his head down and blocks it calmly.
Short of a length on off, Duminy opens up a touch in his stance and glides it to point.
Wood loses his radar and sprays this one down the leg side. JP lets it go.
Back of a length on off, played with an open face to square of the wicket on the off side.
Stays back to the good length delivery angling away from him and guides it to point.
Good length delivery on middle, JP hangs back and pats it to covers.
Starts off his new spell with a bouncer on off, Duminy ducks under it quickly and evades it.
Mark Wood is brought back into the attack. A short leg in place for him.
Full length delivery outside off, Elgar prods forward and plays it with an open face to point.
Back of a length on off, Elgar hops back and turns it to mid-wicket. Stokes is getting inward shape but he needs to control his line.
Stokes errs in line again and slips this one down the leg side. The Protea skipper fails to flick it.
In the channel outside off, jags in a touch. Dean covers his off pole and doesn't fiddle with it.

Leg bye! Fullish in length and tailing down, Duminy moves inside the line a touch and looks to work it across but misses to get rapped on the pads and the ball rolls towards fine leg. An appeal for an LBW is turned down. Replays show that it was heading down leg. A leg bye taken.
Mark Wood can be seen warming up.
Straying on the pads, Elgar works it around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Well played! A bit short on off, Duminy makes good use of the crease and cuts it behind point for a boundary.
Plays this one to covers gently.
JP uses his feet to this one and manages to defend it with his bat and pad close together.
Flighted delivery, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

A confident shout for an LBW denied! Tossed up on off, spins away a touch. Duminy kneels and goes for the paddle sweep but misses to get struck on the pads. The ball rolls past the slip fielder and up go the players in an appeal. However, the umpire is not interested. Two leg byes taken. The replays show it would have missed the off stump.
Elgar shuffles a touch and guides the length delivery to point.
Full length delivery on off, Dean pats it to mid off.
Fuller in length this time outside off, Dean plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Length delivery outside off, Elgar plays it with soft hands to covers.
Dug in short and angling in from around off. Elgar ducks under it to let it sail through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, pretty wide to make Elgar play.
Fullish outside off, Duminy lets it go. Ali bags a wicket-maiden to his name.
A bit shorter this time, pushed off the back foot to covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Coming in with the arm this time, Duminy manages to defend it to point.
Floated around off, eased to covers.
JP Duminy strides out to bat.

OUT! Moeen strikes! He has got the big fish and jumps in joy. Tosses this one nicely outside off, gets it to grip and turn in appreciably from the rough patch. Amla shuffles a touch and looks to clip it across but misses to get pinged on the pads. There is a confident shout in unison from the Englishmen and up goes the umpire's finger. This is a very important breakthrough for the home side. They need to keep chipping away at the wickets.
Full length delivery on middle, clipped to short mid on.
Good length ball outside off, pretty wide and Dean lets it go.
7th Test Fifty for Dean Elgar.

FOUR! On a length outside off, Elgar guides it through the gully region and the ball races to the fence. It has been a gritty knock from the Protea skipper. Well-deserved and he needs to convert it into a big one.
Fuller in length outside off, left alone.
Well bowled! Back of a length delivery around off, straightens a touch with a bit of extra bounce. Elgar pokes at it but gets beaten.
Good length delivery angling in from outside off, Elgar camps back and defends it to short cover.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Elgar eases it through mid on for a run and he will retain the strike.
Flighted delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Floated outside off, spins away. Elgar presses forward in defense.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Good use of the feet from Elgar. This one drifts in with the arm, Elgar backs away a touch, takes a couple of steps down the track and drills it past the bowler for a boundary.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, turned to mid-wicket.

Better line this time. In the fifth stump channel and holding its line. Amla covers his stumps and allows it through safely. Good comeback from Stokes after being hit for two boundaries in his first two deliveries.
A bit wider outside off this time, Amla doesn't fiddle with it.
In the corridor of uncertainty and on a driving length, shapes away a touch. Amla resists the temptation and leaves it alone.
No ball! Length delivery on middle and off, defended stoutly by the Amla. Stokes has overstepped on this occasion. He hasn't settled into a rhythm yet.
Fuller in length on off, Amla shuffles a touch and defends it calmly.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Amla. He is looking in good flow. On a length and straight once again. Hashim whips it through mid-wicket to find the fence.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Angling into the pads, Amla uses the depth of the crease and works it through square leg for a boundary.
Ben Stokes comes into the attack.
Floated outside off, turns away slightly. Elgar comes forward and defends it nicely to covers. A good steady beginning from Ali.
Loopy delivery on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Gets right forward to this one and defends it to the off side.
Fullish on middle, Elgar jams it to mid on and looks for a run. Decides against it as there wasn't a single on offer.
Flighted outside off, pushed with soft hands to short cover.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Dean lunges forward in defense.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack.
Elgar camps back and pushes it to mid on. Calls for the single and makes it to the other end safely.

This is a good contest between Dawson and Elgar. Keeps it loopy outside off again, Elgar comes down the track and looks to go straight but gets an outside edge. The ball flies past the first slip and rolls towards third man. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Aggression from the Protea skipper! Loopy delivery outside off, Elgar is nimble on his feet and lifts it over mid off for a boundary. Picked his spot to perfection.
Floated outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.

Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, stays low. Amla looks to flick it away but misses to get rapped on the pads and the ball rolls to the leg side. A loud shout for an LBW is turned down. The replays indicate that there might have been an inside edge. A single taken.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Amla whips it through mid-wicket for a brace. Played that well.
A tad fuller on middle, Elgar punches it to mid off. Wood dives and tries to stop it but is unable to do so.
Back of a length on leg stump, Elgar pushes it to mid on.
On a length outside off, Elgar shoulders his arm to it.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.

EDGY FOUR! Back of a length outside off, Elgar tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an outside edge past the third slip fielder who dived to his left but could not stop it. The ball races to the third man fence.
Angling into the pads, Amla flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Time for Drinks.
A tad short on the stumps, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Very full on middle, Elgar drives it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Tosses it up outside off, Elgar plays for the spin but the ball does not. The batsman is beaten on the outside edge.
Quicker and full on middle, Elgar paddles it through short fine leg for a couple.
Square leg in place now. This ploy is mainly to curb Dean Elgar from slog sweeping. He has used that shot to good effect till now.
Flatter on middle, Amla flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. Not a lot of spin against the right-hander.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Sprays it down the leg side, Amla tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Length ball on middle, moves away of the pitch. Elgar tries to flick it but gets a leading edge and the ball rolls to point. His bottom hand came off after defending it.
Bouncer, Elgar does well to duck under it.
A tad fuller outside off, Elgar watchfully lets it through.
Bangs it in short, Elgar tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Bowls a bouncer outside off, Elgar does well to evade it.
Bowled on middle, Amla defends it off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, Amla cuts it to point.
Slightly quicker on middle, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Loopy ball on off, Elgar plays the sweep through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Well swept! Tosses it on off, turns into the batsman. Elgar sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Drifts on the pads, Amla tucks it through square leg for a run.
Shorter in length on the body of the batsman, Elgar tucks it towards square leg.
Length ball angling away, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Sprays on the pads, Amla flicks it to fine leg for a run.
A tad fuller on off, Elgar defends it with soft hands on the off side for a run.
Good length on off, Elgar pushes it to point.
Stuart Broad is out of the field at the moment. He is having a bit of an issue with his left knee and the physio is treating him.
Back of a length on middle, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Drags his length back a little outside off, Amla punches it off the back foot through point for a couple.
Gives it air on middle, Amla tucks it on the leg side.
Loopy ball on off, Elgar sweeps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Silly point in place now.
Sharp turn and bounce for Dawson. Floats it on off, turns into the batsman. Elgar tries  to defend it but gets hit on the forearm and the ball falls on the ground.
Tosses it up outside off, gets some turn out of the rough. Elgar tries to defend it but is struck on the pads.
Bowls it full on leg stump, Amla flicks it through the right of mid on. Broad gives it chase and pushes it back before the boundary. Three runs taken by the batsman.
Time for spin now. Liam Dawson is brought into the attack. The wicket is getting slower and lower and the young spinner will look to make the most of it.
FOUR! WELL TIMED! A tad fuller on middle, Elgar drives it straight down the ground for a boundary. He has timed the ball well.
Lands it on a length on middle, Elgar defends it off the front foot.
Good length on off, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Bangs it in short on middle, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Elgar defends it off the front foot.
A slight halt as there is a bit of an issue with the sightscreen. Dean Elgar has pointed that out. It has been resolved and we are good to go again.
A well-directed bouncer. Elgar ducks under it.
Good length on middle, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Angles it into the pads of the batsman who flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
A tad fuller outside off, Elgar lets it through to the keeper.
Silly mid off in place now.
Lands it on a length outside off, stays a touch low. Elgar lets it through to the keeper.
Hits the length on off, Elgar defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! A tad fuller on off, Elgar pushes it with the full face of the bat back past the bowler. The ball races away to the long off fence.
Lands it on a length outside off, Amla tries to push it but gets it off the outer half through backward point for a couple.
Fullish length, tails back in a little. Amla gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Good length on off, Amla defends it off the back foot.
A tad fuller on middle, Amla defends it off the front foot.
On the pads, Elgar works it down the leg side for a run.
Length ball angling across. Elgar lets it through to the keeper.
Mark Wood comes into the attack.
Brilliant from Broad. He has been on the money on every ball in this over. Fuller length on off, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Similar length ball, Amla plays it off the front foot.
Good length on off, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Amla plays it off the back foot. This is perfect Test match bowling from Broad.
Back of a length on off, Amla defends it off the back foot.
Broad bowls it from wide of the crease. Lands it on a length on middle. Amla defends it off the back foot.
Full on the pads, Amla flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bowls it on a length on off, Elgar plays it with soft hands towards covers for a run.
Lands it on a length on off, Elgar guides it to gully.
Good length angling in, Amla tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Length ball outside off, moving in with the slope. Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Drifts it down the leg side, Elgar tries to flick but misses. Jonny dives to his right and collects the ball.
Fullsih length on off, Dean defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length on off, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Sprays it on the pads, Elgar tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. There is a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire. Might be missing leg.
Length ball on the pads, Elgar pushes it to mid on.
A tad fuller outside off, stays a touch low. Elgar lets it through to the keeper.
Bowls it on a length, angling into the batsman. Amla defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lands it on a length on off, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Good length on middle, nips back into the batsman. Elgar gets it off the inner half to fine leg for a run.
Angles it into the batsman, Amla nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Elgar defends it off the back foot towards cover for a run.
Hashim Amla comes out to bat.

OUT! An absolute beauty by Broad. Just the start England wanted after the break. The debutant Kuhn has to depart. A tad fuller on off, Broad gets it to seam away just enough. Kuhn tries to drive but gets an outside edge to first slip where Cook takes a simple catch. South Africa lose their first.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Good length outside off, Kuhn shoulders his arm to it.
Full ball swinging away outside off, Kuhn lets it through watchfully.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.
Length outside off, the batsman lets it through to the keeper.
Stuart Broad to bowl from the other end.

Lands it on a length on leg stump, Elgar tries to flick it but misses and it hits him high on the pads. The ball lobs towards gully and there are shouts of catch it. However, it carries on the bounce to the fielder stationed there. The replays shows that there was an inside edge. Hence, the excitement. A good over by Anderson. Starts off after the lunch break with a maiden.
A tad fuller outside off, the batsman does not bother to play at it.
Good length outside off, Dean guides it to point.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar lets it through to the keeper.
Length ball on off, Elgar pokes at it and gets an outside edge. The ball falls short of Cook at first slip.
Starts off with a loosener outside off, Elgar shoulders his arms to it.
We are back for the afternoon session. Dean Elgar and Heino Kuhn to continue their innings. James Anderson to continue his spell. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...
...Day 2, Session 2...

South Africa have managed to not lose a wicket and survive this tricky period. England were tight with their lines and lengths but had little assistance from the wicket. The visitors would look to play the new ball out and build good partnerships. The hosts on the other hand would try to create early inroads in the South African batting line-up. Join us in a while for the afternoon session.
A nothing delivery. Length outside off, Kuhn lets it through to the keeper. Should have made the batsman play.  THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2.
Lands it on a length on off, Elgar defends it off the front foot. One ball to go for lunch.
Good length outside off, the batsman does not bother playing a shot at it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angles it into the pads, Dean nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
BEATEN! Length outside off, Elgar pokes at it but gets beaten.
A tad fuller outside off, Kuhn drives it to point.
Good length on off, Elgar drops it towards covers and runs a quick single. Good batting.
FOUR! SHOT! Full and outside off, Elgar drives it through covers for a boundary. First boundary of the day for South Africa.

Was there an edge? Length ball on middle, nips away after pitching. Elgar tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten. There was a sound when the ball passed the bat but it was of the bat hitting the pad.
Good length on middle, Dean defends it off the back foot. Anderson is bowling good lines and lengths here.
A tad fuller swinging away on off, Elgar defends it off the front foot.
Length outside off, Kuhn lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

CLOSE SHAVE! Length ball on middle, Elgar nudges it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. Dawson collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. They complete the run. Had Liam hit, Elgar would have been a goner.
Back of a length on middle, Elgar punches it to mid on.
Comes around the wicket. Bowls it on a length on off, Elgar defends it off the front foot.
First run for Heino Kuhn in Test cricket. Back of a length on off, Kuhn punches it off the back foot through covers. They run one. He wants a second but is sent back by his skipper.
Just ahead of a length on off, Elgar defends it off the front foot. A tidy over to start with by Anderson.
Lands it on a length on off, Dean defends it off the front foot.
Good length outside off, the batsman guides it down to third man for a couple. South Africa are underway.
Lovely stuff from Anderson! Back of a length outside off, gets some extra bounce. Elgar does well to drop his wrist in time.
Back of a length on off, Elgar defends it off the back foot.
Starts off on a length, angling away. Elgar defends it off the back foot.
